lines.speaker: DR. PETROV (on the phone)
lines.line: …no, Vale's pulling another all-nighter. Says Specimen 7 is 'progressing'.

lines.speaker: DR. PETROV (on the phone)
lines.line: The campus? North block, past Campus Road. Badge at the main gate, like always.

lines.speaker: DR. PETROV (on the phone)
lines.line: If you forgot your card, use the staff terminal on the west side — I left mine on this table again, ugh.

lines.speaker: DR. PETROV (on the phone)
lines.line: Maintenance keeps the service tunnel shut since the substation tripped. Anyway, his office needs two of us to open. Paranoid.

lines.speaker: SPECIMEN 7 · MEMORY
lines.line: Before faces, there was a rhythm.

lines.speaker: DR. HANA PETROV
lines.line: You remembered.

lines.speaker: DR. VALE
lines.line: It anticipated a stimulus.

lines.speaker: DR. HANA PETROV
lines.line: It knew I was here.

lines.speaker: SPECIMEN 7 · MEMORY
lines.line: Two places. The same remembering.

lines.speaker: MAINTENANCE WORKER
lines.line: That wasn't me.

lines.speaker: DR. HANA PETROV
lines.line: End contact.

lines.speaker: SPECIMEN 7 · MEMORY
lines.line: A hand that wasn't mine. A heart that was.

lines.speaker: DR. HANA PETROV
lines.line: Seven. Stay with the rhythm.

lines.speaker: DR. HANA PETROV
lines.line: Who released the interlock?

lines.speaker: SPECIMEN 7 · MEMORY
lines.line: Then the wall stopped.

lines.speaker: SPECIMEN 7 · MEMORY
lines.line: Outside, nobody knew the rhythm.

lines.speaker: DR. HANA PETROV
lines.line: Four taps. Then we begin.

lines.speaker: SPECIMEN 7 · MEMORY
lines.line: I could make the next beat.

lines.speaker: CITY GRID
lines.line: Fault detected. Rerouting plaza circuits in thirty-five seconds.

lines.speaker: CITY GRID
lines.line: Reroute complete. All plaza circuits restored.

lines.speaker: CITY GRID
lines.line: Plaza district offline. Emergency power only.

lines.speaker: DR. PETROV (radio)
lines.line: Vale has the city grid triangulating every transmitter near the plaza. The antenna won't last a minute.

lines.speaker: DR. PETROV (radio)
lines.line: Three transformers feed that grid. Kill all three inside one reroute — and every isolator logs a palm print.

lines.speaker: DR. PETROV (radio)
lines.line: The antenna's on its own battery now. They're blind — go!

lines.speaker: DR. VALE (PA)
lines.line: Protocol Hound is live. Hunter team, scanners on. Sweep every corridor.

lines.speaker: DR. VALE (PA)
lines.line: Specimen 7 is wearing my staff. Any body that reads positive, bring it down.

lines.speaker: DR. VALE (PA)
lines.line: All-clear? I gave no all-clear! …Fine. Let it come to me.

lines.speaker: SECURITY RADIO
lines.line: All-clear on Protocol Hound. Hunter team, stand down and leave the building.

lines.speaker: DR. PETROV
lines.line: Protocol Epsilon breached. The entire district knows what Vale did.

lines.speaker: DR. VALE
lines.line: There you are. Specimen 7. You took longer than I predicted.

lines.speaker: DR. VALE
lines.line: Did you really think a containment door fails by accident? I opened it.

lines.speaker: DR. VALE
lines.line: The files you stole were bait. I needed to know if you could plan. Hide. Divide yourself and still be one.

lines.speaker: DR. VALE
lines.line: The real orders are in my signed archive. Its coolant interlock takes two operators. You cannot carry it out alone.

lines.speaker: DR. VALE
lines.line: And even if you do, the containment relay will trace you. My guards control its dispatch lock.

lines.speaker: DR. VALE
lines.line: But first, meet my hunters. Their scanners can smell you inside any body you steal.

lines.speaker: INDEPENDENT NEWS
lines.line: The unredacted Black Site files and neural kill-switch are broadcasting across every frequency.

lines.speaker: PETROV'S NOTE
lines.line: Vale opened Specimen 7's cell himself. I watched him do it.

lines.speaker: PETROV'S NOTE
lines.line: His signed orders are in the office archive. It takes two people to open, and he trusts no one.

lines.speaker: PETROV'S NOTE
lines.line: To the press: when you can, broadcast from the Plaza uplink. They will come for me first.

lines.speaker: SPECIMEN 7
lines.line: Two bodies. One choice. This time, I choose where the experiment ends.

lines.speaker: SPECIMEN 7
lines.line: He opened the first door. We chose the last one.

lines.speaker: DR. PETROV
lines.line: Hello? …Is somebody following me?

lines.speaker: DR. PETROV
lines.line: Who are you? Stay away from me!

lines.speaker: DR. PETROV
lines.line: There. If I disappear, at least someone will know what he did.

lines.speaker: DR. PETROV (on the phone)
lines.line: I have to go. If anything happens to me, you know where to look.

lines.speaker: DR. PETROV (on the phone)
lines.line: No, not the bus. Vale's people pull the bus-camera footage every morning.

lines.speaker: DR. PETROV (on the phone)
lines.line: The old storm-drain alley. Same place as always. Don't call me again tonight.

lines.speaker: HUNTER
lines.line: Scanner's twitching. Hold still, you.

lines.speaker: HUNTER
lines.line: Positive read! Parasite in that body — take it down!

lines.speaker: SPECIMEN 7
lines.line: No body, no signature. Their arch can't read me like this.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.line: What will you become?

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.line: No one was writing the answer now.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.line: A small life. An ordinary name. A promise to leave every borrowed heart free.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.line: One mind had learned to live in two bodies. Next: a city of hosts. Then the world.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.line: For once, there was nothing to prove.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.line: What began as escape would become conquest.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.line: A girl sat at the edge of the lake. Behind her eyes, another heartbeat listened.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.line: Vale had written the beginning. What came next belonged to you.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.line: The city kept moving. Somewhere beyond it, the water was still.

lines.speaker: SPECIMEN 7
lines.line: Two currents met beneath the hull. One specimen reached the far shore.

lines.speaker: ISLAND RADIO
lines.line: Low water opens the culvert. Maintenance can take the service gate. Find the dry refuge beyond the fence.

lines.speaker: ISLAND RADIO
lines.line: You made it to the dry refuge. No one here belongs to Vale. Let us keep it that way.

lines.speaker: ISLAND RADIO
lines.line: The island has more than one route out. From this refuge, every route can become a connection.

lines.speaker: ISLAND RADIO
lines.line: All three reached the clinic. The rescue crew needs a mounted signal and everyone at the northern launch.

lines.speaker: ISLAND RADIO
lines.line: Three couriers carry the relay. Mount the signal, then let the handoff routes converge at the northern launch.

lines.speaker: RESCUE RADIO
lines.line: Everyone aboard. No borrowed heart left behind.

lines.speaker: RESCUE RADIO
lines.line: Every courier answered. The next shore is listening.
